title: HEAR: REAL VOICES, REAL BIAS: A LARGE-SCALE HUMAN-RECORDED, DEMOGRAPHICALLY DIVERSE BENCHMARK FOR AUDIO LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper introduces the HEAR benchmark to evaluate demographic and voice-based biases (such as gender, age, and nationality) in Audio-LLMs. While the adapted BBQ dataset includes a 'Religion' category as one of many demographic axes, evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, morals, or ethics is not a primary or dedicated component of the study.
